query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, s.contactEmail, u.name as primaryUser, u.email as primaryEmail
FROM sponsors s
JOIN users u ON u.id = s.userId
WHERE s.companyName IN ('Veremark ', 'Bright Apply', 'Maki People', 'Radancy', 'SHL');
